test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 08 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which state government launched the Mission Bhumiputra in August 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Mission Bhumiputra Portal** was recently introduced by **Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma.**
 
• This portal's goal is to give pupils access to digitalized caste certificates within a month.
 
• In October 2021, the state **government** also started** Mission Basundhara** with the goal of resolving issues relating to land. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mission Bhumiputra**

 
 
• ​For both students and** Assamese citizens**, a caste certificate is a necessary document. Prior to now, obtaining a caste certificate required individuals to go to the appropriate government office.
 
• **Mission Bhumiputra** is a new platform that the **Hon**. **Chief Minister of Assam, Dr Himanta Biswa Sharma,** has introduced for the online application of caste certificates in **Assam**.
 
• An online platform called **Assam Mission Bhumiputra **was created to make it easier and quicker for residents to get caste certificates directly.
 
• When applying for certain** government employment, government programmes,** or admittance to schools and colleges, these cast certifications could be necessary.
 
• The entire procedure for applying for a caste certificate online through the **Mission Bhumiputra portal** is outlined here.
